authorityReview.evidence: This exact payable zero-argument method uses msg.value, calls _stake(msg.sender, msg.value, LockStrategy.Claimable), then claimAETH(). The inspected body requires positive native value and paused/nonreentrant conditions, computes shares through the fixed configured _aethContract bondsToShares path, mints those shares to this pool and credits only the caller's claimable-share balance, then claimAETH resets that caller credit and transfers shares from the same configured token to msg.sender. Protocol pause, share calculation/mint, zero claim, or token transfer can revert. This does not authorize arbitrary targets/calldata or imply a separate platform amount/receiver/feed/balance restriction; existing root native-value budgets remain in force. Documentation naming ankrETH does not prove current _aethContract storage/configuration, proxy implementation, funding, execution outcome, or financial safety. The deprecated stake alias, standalone claim, validator/admin, unstake/withdraw, and all other methods are excluded.
